notes: Source: Stark County BOE 'Candidates List' dated 10/15/2026, 'Questions and Issues List' (numbered) and the board's updated FWAB 46-day election notice (Nov 26_46_updated.pdf), all linked from starkcountyohio.gov/government/offices/board_of_elections. No municipal, township or school-board candidate races appear on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot (Ohio elects those in odd years); only county offices and county judgeships are listed. The board's candidate list shows a nominating party for each Common Pleas judge (Farmer R; Forchione D; Moore D and Dave R for the 2-9-2027 seat; Werren R) but Ohio common pleas judicial races appear on the ballot without party, so party is null per RULES. County Commissioner is the seat with full term commencing 1-1-2027. Issue 4 (Stark County Library District renewal + increase) is a library-district levy, not a countywide vote: it covers the district's precincts across Stark, Carroll, Portage and Summit counties (Canton, parts of Massillon/North Canton, Meyers Lake and most townships; see FWAB notice for the precinct list) — scope set to county with area null because the schema has no special-district scope. Issue 9 (SARTA sales tax) is countywide. The Wayne County Joint Vocational School District renewal levy carries no Stark issue number (numbered by Wayne County BOE) and appears only in Sugarcreek Twp. precinct 2 (part); included without a number. Issue 5 Plain Local bond amount is $116,802,000 on the issues list and $116,800,000 (rounded) on the FWAB notice; the issues-list figure is used. Issues 10/11 East Sparta, 13 Beach City, 17 Magnolia, 18 Navarre and 19 Wilmot are villages (scope city). Liquor options use the board's precinct names. Issue 3 (state constitutional amendment) omitted per RULES. No write-in-only county races.
